visual.detail: Manager must inspect all views for placement, proportions, missing/extra parts and visible intersections
visual.observation: Square asteroid-belt tile, coherent and symmetric. Top view: one smooth circular landing pad centred in the face with a ring of flat-topped rubble boulders around it, all inside the tile's rounded-square outline, none crossing the edge. Front view: every boulder is a separate flat-topped block on the recessed floor, none spiked, nothing overhanging the tile. Iso: one solid, no floating or intersecting bodies. Nothing missing, nothing extra; proportions match a 33.50 mm tile for a 36.00 mm cell.
